source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of debugging techniques (PDF 63-64).

items: Print statements: code ke mukhtalif marahil par variables ki qeematein print karna.
Debugging tools: pdb, Python Debugger, code qadam ba qadam chalata, variables dikhata aur chalne ka bahao batata hai.
Error messages: masle ki jagah dhoondne ke liye inhein parhna aur samajhna.
